nodes.name: TicketCategoryMapper.java

nodes.name: ProgramService.java
nodes.summary: Core service of the program domain: program CRUD, multi-level caching (local cache, Redis, Elasticsearch), detail/search/list queries with distributed locks, and preloading of ticket-user and order-count data.
nodes.languageNotes: Combines local cache, RedisCache and Elasticsearch with ServiceLockTool and repeat-execute limiting for high-concurrency reads.

nodes.name: ProgramShowTimeService.java
nodes.summary: Service managing program show times: adding show times with generated ids and multi-level cached lookup plus Redis-lock-protected renewal of show-time data.

nodes.summary: Caffeine-based local in-memory cache for ProgramVo detail data with lock-protected initialization and TTL expiry.

nodes.name: LocalCacheProgramGroup.java
nodes.summary: Caffeine-based local in-memory cache for ProgramGroupVo data with lock-protected initialization and TTL expiry.

nodes.name: ProgramService
nodes.summary: Program domain service orchestrating DB, local cache, Redis and Elasticsearch access with lock protection.

nodes.name: ProgramShowTimeService
nodes.summary: Show-time service with cached lookups and lock-protected renewal logic.

nodes.name: LocalCacheProgram
nodes.summary: Caffeine local cache wrapper for ProgramVo entries.

nodes.name: LocalCacheProgramGroup
nodes.summary: Caffeine local cache wrapper for ProgramGroupVo entries.

nodes.name: dbSelectHomeList
nodes.summary: Queries homepage program lists directly from the database grouped by program category and show time.

nodes.name: setQueryTime
nodes.summary: Computes the effective query time range for program listings based on the requested time type.

nodes.name: dbSelectPage
nodes.summary: Executes a paged program query against the database, resolving area names via the base-data client.

nodes.name: getDetail
nodes.summary: Assembles a full program detail view including group, category map and ticket category data.

nodes.name: getDetailV2
nodes.summary: V2 detail assembly returning the extended ProgramVo with additional preloaded data.

nodes.name: getByIdMultipleCache
nodes.summary: Fetches a ProgramVo through the multi-level cache chain (local cache backed by Redis/DB loader).

nodes.name: simpleGetProgramAndShowMultipleCache
nodes.summary: Fetches a program plus its show time through the multi-level cache, returning a combined view.

nodes.name: getById
nodes.summary: Loads a program detail from cache or DB under a reentrant distributed lock to prevent cache breakdown.

nodes.name: getProgramGroup
nodes.summary: Loads a program group from cache or DB under a reentrant distributed lock.

nodes.name: operateProgramData
nodes.summary: Applies program-data updates (e.g. remaining ticket counts) to cache and database after order operations.

nodes.name: createProgramVo
nodes.summary: Builds a ProgramVo from the Program entity, enriching it with area data from the base-data client.

nodes.name: getDetailFromDb
nodes.summary: Loads the complete program detail from the database as the fallback path of the cache chain.

nodes.name: preloadTicketUserList
nodes.summary: Preloads ticket-buyer verification data from the user service into Redis with per-user token expiry.

nodes.name: preloadAccountOrderCount
nodes.summary: Preloads per-account order counts from the order service into Redis for purchase-limit checks.

nodes.name: resetExecute
nodes.summary: Resets program execution data: refreshes caches and re-pushes program data for a clean selling state.

nodes.name: delRedisData
nodes.summary: Deletes all Redis keys related to a program via the Lua-based cache deletion handler.

nodes.name: invalid
nodes.summary: Marks a program as invalid, removes its Elasticsearch document and pushes a Redis Stream message for downstream consumers.

nodes.name: selectProgramShowTimeByProgramId
nodes.summary: Loads the show time for a program from cache or DB under a reentrant distributed lock.

nodes.name: renewal
nodes.summary: Renews show-time data by reconciling DB state with cached data under lock protection.

nodes.name: localLockCacheInit
nodes.summary: Initializes the Caffeine cache with expire-after-write TTL and a loader guarded for single-flight loading.

nodes.name: localLockCacheInit
nodes.summary: Initializes the Caffeine cache for program groups with TTL expiry and a guarded loader.
